NewDishes.description: Experience the ultimate taste of our freshly crafted menu. From sizzling steaks to mouth-watering ribs, every bite is a testament to the art of grilling meeting excellence. Discover our newest additions and elevate your dining experience today!

ChickenSpecials.description: Experience the ultimate taste of our freshly crafted menu. From sizzling steaks to mouth-watering ribs, every bite is a testament to the art of grilling meeting excellence. Discover our newest additions and elevate your dining experience today!

BeefLambSpecials.heading: GRILLADO'S BEEF & LAMB SPECIALS
BeefLambSpecials.description: Grillado's Beef & Lamb Specials offer a mouthwatering selection of tender, perfectly seasoned cuts, expertly grilled to perfection. From juicy steaks to succulent lamb chops, each dish is crafted with high-quality ingredients and bold flavors, ensuring a memorable dining experience for meat lovers.

Sandwiches.heading: GRILLADO'S SANDWICHES / PITAS / WRAPS
Sandwiches.description: Grillado's Sandwiches, Pitas, and Wraps offer a delicious variety of freshly grilled meats wrapped in warm, soft bread or pitas. Packed with fresh veggies and signature sauces, each option delivers a perfect balance of bold flavors and satisfying textures for a quick, mouthwatering meal.

Platters.heading: GRILLADO'S PLATTERS
Platters.description: Grillado's Platters offer a generous, satisfying feast featuring a perfect combination of expertly grilled meats, vibrant sides, and savory sauces. Whether you're craving tender chicken, succulent beef, or hearty lamb, each platter is crafted to deliver bold, unforgettable flavors in every bite, perfect for sharing or indulging yourself.

Appetizers.heading: APPETIZERS
Appetizers.description: Grillado's appetizers are flavorful, grilled bites that showcase a variety of ingredients, often skewered for easy enjoyment. These appetizers typically feature marinated vegetables, meats, or seafood, cooked to perfection over an open flame, enhancing their natural flavors with a smoky char.

CateringIntroduction.titleBlack:
Customized food.
Catering at its best.
CateringIntroduction.p1: Grillados caters to a wide range of events, including weddings of all sizes, styles, and themes, as well as birthdays, anniversary parties, and family gatherings. Whether it's a corporate event or a community activity, we offer delicious and visually stunning dishes, tailored to your preferences, to elevate your event and create lasting memories.
CateringIntroduction.p2: At Grillado, you are our priority. We listen carefully to understand your objectives, leveraging our decades of experience and commitment to exceeding your expectations to ensure the success of your event in every aspect.
CateringIntroduction.p3: Customized menus: Our team works closely with you to develop a menu that reflects your tastes and dietary needs. Whether it's a wedding, a corporate event, or an intimate gathering, we create dishes that will delight every guest.
CateringIntroduction.p4: We pride ourselves on using only the highest quality, organic, and locally sourced ingredients. Our commitment to freshness and sustainability ensures that every bite is both delicious and nutritious.
CateringIntroduction.p5: At Grillado, our mission is to elevate your catering experience with personalized, high-quality cuisine that leaves a lasting impression. We are committed to exceeding your expectations and transforming your special occasion into a true culinary masterpiece.

CustomizedOptions.heading: Customized Options
CustomizedOptions.feature1: All items can be individually packed or served on catering trays.
CustomizedOptions.feature2: Serving stands and food warming equipment are available.
CustomizedOptions.feature3: Add extra bottles of sauce for an additional charge.
